_comment: Kinora's own descriptor for the VIDAA app, not an official VIDAA manifest (VIDAA publishes no public package format: store apps are hosted web apps registered by VIDAA). tv/build.mjs fills in the name, version and, with --url, the hosted address, and writes it as vidaa-app.json. Its fields mirror the launcher entries VIDAA keeps for web apps (websdk/Appinfo.json), so the same values go into the VIDAA partner submission form or a developer-mode install.
Title: Kinora
Description: Your Kinora server on a Hisense VIDAA TV.
